agents.description: One AI participant per original human subject, in a fresh context.

roles.subject: reads own scenario, (load) counting task, rates items

scripted_roles_justification: The paper describes no confederates or experimenter script.
order: (load) end number, effort split, difficulty, effort
visibility: Each participant sees only own materials; no other participant's responses (between-subjects).
population: similar-site English-speaking undergraduates (primary replay target); site type, language and lab setting are not varied
